structure.unit: Titling and Registration of Motor Vehicles

law.catch_line: Fee for certificate of title; use in special fund
law.text: The fee to be paid to the Department for the issuance of each original certificate of title shall be ten dollars. The fee to record a supplemental lien and issue a new title shall be six dollars. All fees collected under the provisions of this section shall be paid into the state treasury and set aside as a special fund to be used to meet the expenses of the Department.
